text.name: Cap of Knowledge
text.description:
{Cap of Knowledge}

Increases the hero's knowledge by 2, and regenerates 2 spell points per day
text.event: In the middle of the road you noticed a magical crown. As you dismounted, a thin man jumped out of cover. He tore off the Cap of Knowledge and quickly pulled on the crown. "Finally I got rid of this stupid hat!" - he shouted, threw it in your direction and just as quickly disappeared into the thicket of the forest.
